programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之铁证待判》继续以游历的方式,走进荷兰、土耳其、约旦、敍利亚,涉及接近50个地点,超过30个已经发生嘅神迹预言、传奇故事,以考古和实证,重新解构连科学都不能解释的千古谜团。 历年来有无数的考古学家和世界知名的纪录片频道,为了解开上帝藉著摩西施行神迹分割红海这个历史迷团,他们都不惜花上大量的财力物力,研发新科技,要到红海的海底寻找历史证据。这集创世电视会直撀约旦,踏足每一处地方,搜罗各种铁证,带你经历摩西如何施行神迹分割红海,从埃及法老王手中,带领以色列人平安走过红海,离开埃及。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人说,人生是一场戏,在人生的过程中,寻找有时、碰壁有时、迷失有时、觉醒有时,说真的,这些起承转合比真正的电影情节更精彩,每一个「你」,都是天父特别设计的人生剧本主角。 今天,我们的世界充满了末世风情,醉生梦死、迷失自我了结生命的悲剧每天上演,创世电视藉100个见证故事挽救生命,100位来自世界各地的见证人,100篇令人万万想不到的剧本,配以崭新的拍摄和剪接手法,滋润都市人的心灵,带来生命的觉醒。

programme.title: 如果还有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一个人,都需要一个温暖、安全,可以得到庇护的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以与挚爱天家相聚也并非绝对,突如起来的天灾,毫无先兆的顽疾,极速致命的意外,误入歧途的决定,足以令一个家毁于一旦。 第四辑《如果还有明天》搜罗多个见证故事,有50年代经典歌曲《情人的眼泪》原唱者潘秀琼、《阴阳路》编剧、狗仔队之父、被癌症缠扰的中国商人…… 他们的家都曾经陷入崩溃边缘,明天的路更是举步为艰,但在绝望边缘他们遇见上帝,重新发现有一个「家」是永远不被摧毁、不会改变,可以成为他们永恒的避难所。

programme.title: 福气教会讲道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康强盛的教会? 改变社区可以转化城市? 作为基督徒,我们又如何尽忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一个「幸福小组」,让教会续步履行三个使命!由台湾高雄福气教会牧者主讲,从《圣经》的话语开始,一起来学习「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 「创世电视福音主日」- 以巴战争与圣经预言
programme.desc: 「超阔银幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大众化的福音主题」,加上「诚意的款待」会产生极致的「福音体验」

programme.title: 属灵教室:蔡锦图博士-小先知书的大意义
属灵教室:李盛林牧师-出埃及记
programme.desc: 前无去路,后有追兵,凭信心过红海。 云柱火柱日夜引路,天降吗哪为持生命。 流浪旷野四十年,以色列人用血﹑泪﹑性命写成的感人见证! 今天,对你有甚么启示呢? 李盛林牧师与你深入探讨《出埃及记》中的主要资讯,让信徒掌握此书卷之意义,并如何落实应用于现今世代。

programme.title: 喜乐婆婆会客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子乔妈,人称「喜乐婆婆」,一生经历操练出一套喜乐心得,她更请来一众嘉宾好友,分享人生中大小风浪,靠著的是同出一辙的喜乐秘诀,在节目中娓娓道出那份属天的快乐。

programme.title: 地球大神秘
programme.desc: 从世界各地搜集到数以百计奇异事物内容,都是无法以一般人接受的观点加以解释,除非这个世界在科学理论上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.desc: 究竟我们可以怎样在生活和事奉里讨主的喜悦?论到《圣经》四福音书,记载了不少耳熟能详关于耶稣的生平事迹。程蒙恩长老提醒我们,可以从这些记载看到主耶稣喜欢什么,我们学习喜欢主耶稣所欢喜的事物,就可以讨主喜悦。

programme.desc: 摄制队走访美国﹑英国﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中国及亚洲等国家,访寻学者专家多年来从大地发掘的宝藏及科研成果,当中包括高山上经历大洪水形成的奇异化石;全球首卷手抄丝绸中文圣经;以色列铸造挪亚方舟金币场等。 一切一切的资料,让观众在欣赏地球的创造同时,见证上帝的奇妙创作及精密设计,从心感受祂对我们的恩典及爱护,同时亦透过昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化问题的共同处,启示人类身为地球管理者,应该好好珍惜及保护地球的责任,改变世界,从你开始。

programme.title: 香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
高朋满座#5粤
programme.desc: 大厦电梯紧急维修，溢满提议跑楼梯回家，众家人借故推塘。溢满近日行为「失常」，全是为了参加马拉松作准备，赢取冠军奖品，与药房伙计混熟，是要他们冒名参加比赛增加胜算。不过比赛当日有朋等出现令溢满好梦成空。

programme.title: 锦心似玉#15粤普
programme.desc: 丹阳在十一娘的提点下，识破了莲房的诡计，并明白到最重要的是与令宽的夫妻之情；诫哥过继给二房，令宽很感激十一娘；十一娘发现琥珀向罗大太太通风报信，并未责怪，仍待之以诚；令宜受十一娘影响，对家人越发宽容。

programme.title: 交易现场粤 及 潮流生活志粤
阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 鼎爷巧妙奉上「一鱼两味」，先把大鱼鱼腩蒸熟拆肉，配合柴鱼汤底、胜瓜丝、木耳丝等，煮出鲜甜足料的「拆鱼羹」。鱼头则下镬香煎，是为甘香惹味的「煎焗鱼脊」。火龙果品种多、营养高，白肉、红肉、紫水晶各有捧场客，另有同科的麒麟果，阿谭分享选「果」心得。火龙果不单能生吃，还可入馔？鼎爷秘制「紫水晶咕噜肉」，色彩缤纷、酸甜醒胃！此外，鼎爷、阿谭在顺德享用当地名菜「豉汁蒸鲮鱼嘴」和「酿鲮鱼」，并道出个中美味精髓。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 肾脏的主要功能包括过滤血液中的代谢废物、调节水分平衡等。临床肿瘤科医生详析肾癌的诊治资讯与预防方法，并提醒吸烟、高血压等都是此症的高危因素，如出现血尿或持续的腰腹部疼痛，应及早求医。竞技叠杯是一项讲求速度与手眼协调的运动，相关团体负责人为观众介绍比赛细节，同来的两位香港代表队成员分享深刻赛事经历。二人更即席示范，并指导主持实际试玩，表现如何？「睇𩠌食饭」环节，陈国宾以龙虾炮制一道「水晶龙王盘」。

programme.title: 医医，我不想再病了粤
programme.desc: 嘉宾李佳芯与陆永，以及C君迎来首个难题，究竟经常啪关节可会受伤？陆永、C君分别从揼骨经验解谜；佳芯对啪关节导致手指变粗的顾虑，又可有根据？有请风湿病科专科医生现身说法。嘌呤是引致痛风恶化的「元凶」！佳芯、C君分别找出可令痛风恶化的日常食物与用品，啤酒、能量饮品、跌打酒同上榜。医生细说痛风的严重性，甚或会影响肾脏，形成痛风石等，后患无穷。营养师亦带来适合痛风患者的果汁，嘉宾能尝出当中的四种水果吗？

programme.title: 乘胜狙击#25粤PG
programme.desc: 骏升愿出五亿酬金，只要美诗能令柏义承认杀人，美诗为钱而答应。骏升认为只要救到林磊才能取得公司控制权，冠一不以为然。一班老千在赌场不停赢钱，骏升私下捉拿老千并报警，事后警告柏义不要再用老千诈取赌场资金。柏义为对付冠一而烦恼，柔紫的话竟启发了他。其西发现兆良到来石澳，担心他为报仇而来，正花却主动找他讲清楚。冠一知道美诗难以在柏义身上套料，决定主动出击，岂料美诗突然倒戈，天龙又现身阻止他，并带走柏义。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 春天和暖令小丸子老是赖床，小丸子打听有何方法令自己顺利起床，并发现花轮教的播音乐方法十分有效。小丸子重新开始集邮，获高丸太太赠送一袋外国邮票，谁知却在里面发现一张印刷歪斜的版票。

programme.title: Hands Up粤 及 成语动画廊粤
programme.desc: 珍珠由贝类孕育而成，原来香港亦有出产。养殖场负责人携来港产珍珠亮相「Kids’ Notes」，并提到早于五代十国时期，香港已有采珠记载。但早年除了要面对水下危机，过度采捕更令行业一度中断。嘉宾详述养殖珍珠的工作与细节，还即场示范开壳取珠。滢仴姐姐好奇剩下的贝肉如何处理，除可制成调味酱料，还能加工成珍珠末、护肤产品。嘉宾亦指养殖珍珠有助净化海洋，详情如何？另外，本集也会播放AI生成动画《狐假虎威》。

programme.title: 多啦A梦粤
programme.desc: 小夫用奇珍异兽作为观察日记的题材，大家也想仿傚，多啦A梦用「动物暂住咭」把奇珍异兽请到家中。明天去露营，但天气预报显示会下雨，大雄跟小夫打赌会放晴，他胸有成竹，皆因有法宝「天气箱」。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 今日有楼睇粤 及 潮流生活志粤
programme.desc: 楼价持续回升，带动业主获利机会增加，沙田一个老牌屋苑，近期不少成交均有钱赚，楼价处于甚么水平？

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 世界观粤 及 招商局集团特约：天气报告粤
有理说得清粤
programme.desc: 两位时事评论员屈颖妍、杨立门，同观众论尽天下事、国家事、香港事；大事小事，开门见山、言无不尽，《有理说得清》！

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 观众报料指屯门一个公厕被人故意破坏，据称是区内童党所为。牛头角某屋苑的商场出现严重漏水，受牵连的商户损失如何？一名已移居外国的长者早前回港，向弟弟提出暂居大埔三门仔的祖屋，兄弟却因此爆发纷争。该祖屋属世袭制的牌照屋，事主翻出文件指自己拥有居住权，但弟弟拒绝协商，事主最终希望透过法律途径解决纠纷……年近岁晚，不少人搜购年货准备过节。然而有骗徒在网上假冒海鲜店出售元贝，个别市民因此受骗。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱． 回家之开心速递#2712粤
programme.desc: 凌凌回港，得知导演坚慌病倒，主动顶替他拍摄《揸流滩》，Bonnie大为感激。凌凌提出不少意见，Bonnie于没法推搪的情况下才允许他改动某一场戏，原来Bonnie亦有为难之处。城安获Bonnie告知剧组的苦况，遂尝试帮忙解决问题，为此作出不少努力，却事与愿违。其后，凌凌再提出特别的拍摄要求，城安决意要向凌凌道出真相，但未能付诸实行。此时，Bonnie对凌凌终于忍无可忍……

programme.title: Return 关节筋肌配方呈献：守诚者#10粤PG
programme.desc: 何浩辉找到鉴证科的石sir想要看到程沛德验尸报告，通过分析得知阿德在当天跟哥哥打架前，还跟别人发生过肢体冲突。经过对街坊的询问，何浩辉得知出事当天阿德似乎与人在小巷内起了冲突，来到小巷寻找监控。

programme.title: 宿敌契约#6粤普PG
programme.desc: 戏阳与一笑见面，在城中闲逛时遇到随歌及静石；随歌擅自写信给静炎请求让静石入赘夙砂，一笑问未然关于平陵之战那天的事，发现未然说谎，一笑得知平陵一战当晚有人假冒客商跟静石见面，静炎答应入赘之事…

programme.title: 尚品花胶专门店呈献:东张今年大件事2025粤
programme.desc: 许多市民遇到各样难题、看不过眼的事情，就会「报东张」。如果邻居是囤积狂，连门口也进不去，《东张西望》团队会联系义工帮忙执拾清理，也关心户主的心理需要。2025年曾获跟进改善的垃圾屋主人，现时生活如何？性格有甚么转变？节目组探访时还「偶遇」旧老友，热爱唱歌的「含遮男」！过往到运输署办理牌照相关事宜，有可能要与图利的排队党「大战」一番。经《东张西望》报道后，当局于8月有新政策，但似乎令问题变得更严重？

programme.title: 娱乐头条粤 及 中信银行(国际) 外汇交易平台呈献：环球新闻档案粤
programme.desc: 节目主要以当日的娱乐新闻作重点，让你瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈动态和最新消息，并以「娱乐大事件」、「抢闸头条」、「出炉猛料」等为主题作头条新闻式报道。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 招商局集团特约：天气报告粤 及 潮流生活志粤
名媛望族#11粤PG
programme.desc: 卓万向心兰提出要娶子君为四姨太，心兰痛心。卓万要求尔嫣负责监督子君新房的装修，尔嫣答允。启燊向父亲表示全家人都因他要娶子君而不高兴，自己亦不认同父亲的做法；启烨与启燊讨论，启烨提醒兄长应了解子君感受。

programme.title: 医医，我不想再病了粤

programme.title: 乘胜狙击#26粤PG

programme.desc: 香港街道人如潮涌，路上擦身而过，本应相安无事，四位「猛人」敲脚婆婆、伸拳姐、踩脚姐及飞脚姐，却为途人带来滋扰，甚至潜在伤害。节目组重新寻找她们的踪影，有人死性不改，有人变得「温柔」？一宗银行地库保险箱水浸个案，揭出失去楼契正本的严重后果，陆续有更多误购无契楼的报道，「东张」宗旨是提醒准业主们免招损失！演唱会盛事连连，同时惹来骗徒「捞油水」，这集回顾涉款千万的内部飞骗局来龙去脉，警惕乐迷购票要小心。

programme.title: 交易现场粤 及 潮流生活志粤
阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 鼎爷与阿谭清早来到逢简河畔，探究顺德河鲜肥美鲜甜的因由。二人吃过驰名顺德鱼粥后意犹未尽，鼎爷选用大鱼鱼头，炮制据称有去头风疗效的「川芎白芷天麻炖鱼头汤」，个中美味连阿谭亦食指大动！及后烹调的「荷叶蒸鸡」同样用料十足，除了用上虫草花、冬菇、云耳、红枣，鼎爷还特别以干荷叶与新鲜荷叶包着鸡项蒸煮，成品究竟有多滋味？挑选刀具要讲究，去除鱼腥、泥味亦有学问，鼎爷于示范期间逐一公开他的私房烹饪心得。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 化妆前护肤、化妆品选择、卸妆后护肤原来都大有学问，医生分享专业意见，助大家保持肌肤健康。有指旅行时特别容易诱发皮肤过敏，医生细说个中原因，并提供应对暗疮、皮肤黯沉等肌肤问题的方法。透过体重与身高，可计算自己可会超重，标准数值为何？外科医生亦会详析生活型态调整、药物治疗、介入治疗等体重控制方案，还带来培养健康生活习惯的建议。「睇𩠌食饭」环节，保哥呈献一道「鸿运脆鸡配柚子汁」，既惹味又开胃。

programme.title: 医医，我不想再病了粤
programme.desc: 多吃蔬果仍会便秘？「大王」安德尊与焦浩轩，林颖彤与狄易达两组嘉宾都带出水、油对排便的重要，营养师讲解两者的作用。排便状况与肠道的好、坏菌息息相关，甚么食物含有益肠道的益生原？放屁是正常生理反应，屁的气味反映身体状况，肠胃肝脏科专科医生解释不同屁味的成因。甚么颜色的粪便反映可能患上大肠癌？大王一组为了突破零的局面，无所不用其极，终于靠反驳成功得分。另外，还会带来一款以奇亚籽制作的健肠布甸。

programme.title: 乘胜狙击#27粤PG
programme.desc: 骏升感谢众人为他重夺娱乐城主席之位，送上礼物并当众向月华求婚。天龙得知婚讯，大发脾气，柔紫质问天龙有否爱过她。月华及骏升的婚礼上，天龙持枪扫射，月华甘为骏升挡枪。冠一追着天龙到蒋庐，天龙誓要杀死冠一，想逃离时却发现秘道被封。正花过马路时失神，兆良出手救之，并感谢她与冠一让他明白为爱人牺牲之道。冠一在老人院装上炸弹，希望炸死柏义，柏义逃离现场并与冠一扭打，冠一遭棚架压伤，柏义终等到处决冠一的时机……

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 临近岁晚，小丸子从丸尾口中得知「收炉」的概念，于是决定随爸爸去钓鱼，吃顿好的去收炉。小丸子收拾时三心两意，结果错过百惠的表演，她把一切归咎于烦恼，决定在除夕夜去撞钟以驱散烦恼。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 小丸子打算储钱，但每次一收到零用钱便马上花光，于是想到一个办法，便是把钱藏起来再把事情忘记。爷爷想到自己老是宠爱小丸子一个，冷落了姐姐，于是千方百计去宠爱姐姐，却落得两面不是人。

programme.title: Hands Up粤 及 成语动画廊粤
programme.desc: 香港水域拥有丰富海洋生态，吸引不少潜水爱好者下海探索。本集「Kids’ Notes」邀请海洋保育团体的两位代表，引领大家认识本港海洋的魅力。浮潜可视为探索海洋的入门体验，已能欣赏到珊瑚、魔鬼鱼等有趣的海洋生物，参与活动时有甚么要注意？嘉宾提醒水下可能会出现「鬼网」，有机会对海洋生物、潜水员、船只造成伤害，这却是人类所制造？嘉宾还分享如何为清除鬼网出力，并介绍常见的海洋垃圾，也呼吁大家共同守护海洋。

programme.title: 魔神创造传粤日
programme.desc: 玛萝带大家去可以知道世界真相的地方，谁知目的地竟是炎上达的家。众人跳进湖中，去到另一个世界，并在那里遇见玄武、白虎、凤凰和玛萝的弟弟月读。月读揭开玛萝的真正身分，令众人感到震惊。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 今日有楼睇粤 及 潮流生活志粤
programme.desc: 笔架山有新盘交楼，客厅地台出现轻微空鼓，厨房红酒柜没固定好，露台排水速度也比较慢，要怎样执修？

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 世界观粤 及 招商局集团特约：天气报告粤
有理说得清粤
programme.desc: 两位时事评论员屈颖妍、杨立门，同观众论尽天下事、国家事、香港事；大事小事，开门见山、言无不尽，《有理说得清》！

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱． 回家之开心速递#2714粤
programme.desc: 加入接龙餐饮部的Venus锐意「钓金龟」，并锁定Joe为新目标。Joe与壮及餐饮部众人开会时，偶然发现一件披肩，Joe打算购买同款送赠天娥。Venus冒认披肩为己物，借花敬佛，怎料披肩原是壮亲手编织，本欲送赠Elaine，两人因此结怨，展开恶斗。Elaine充当和事老，Venus遂设法逼壮讲和，并与他达成共识，在感情事上互相帮忙。除夕夜，Venus向Joe展开攻势，壮则向Elaine表白，讵料……

programme.title: Return 关节筋肌配方呈献 :守诚者#12粤PG
programme.desc: 时间临近周一，高层施压尽快破案，何浩辉提示陈耀扬要从关女士处突破。陈耀扬听取建议，用林蔚言拍到的姜、韦二人的照片攻破了关女士心房，关女士说分手费是姜议员提出的，承诺到手后一人一半，并且二人还签了合同。

programme.title: 宿敌契约#8粤普
programme.desc: 凤随歌公然顶撞凤平城，并抗旨提起母亲，被恼怒的平城下令回府反省，戏阳大婚大典前的祭祖大典改由二皇子亚献。付一笑追问面具人究竟是谁，但夏静石避重就轻，转移话题求一笑回到他身边，一笑心灰意冷，决然离开。

programme.title: 尚品花胶专门店呈献:东张今年大件事2025粤
programme.desc: 本年「东张」报道过不少骗案，个中的情骗令人印象深刻，一于综合骗徒常用套路。不同的情骗，有两位事主更可谓网民心目中的「最佳女主角」？熟龄女子因网恋「帅男」而与家人反目，报道播出后引来外界大量批评，据悉当事人对这些负评疑有不满……曾深信跟「刘天王」对话的婆婆，则拆解受访时金句「够胆呃我就够胆畀你」的背后信念。这集亦回顾补习社少女职员遭性骚扰的个案。主持更藉节目感谢观众支持，同时却要为某些报料人致歉？

programme.title: 娱乐头条粤 及 中信银行(国际) 外汇交易平台呈献：环球新闻档案粤

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 招商局集团特约：天气报告粤
香港旅游发展局呈献:香港跨年倒数粤
programme.desc: 迎接2026的香港跨年倒数活动，在中环遮打道行人专用区举行，国际组合Air Supply瞩目登场，本地歌手冯允谦及云浩影亦会现场献唱。此外，中环共八幢建筑物外墙，会以巨型倒数时钟及光影图案，跟大众一起倒数，并上演以「新希望、新开始」为主题的光影表演，向市民与旅客传递正能量与祝福，让大家携手迈进新一年。

programme.title: 盛世鸣钟 福佑香江2026
肥龙过江粤PG
programme.desc: 模范警员朱福龙因未婚妻悔婚而自暴自弃，变成一个200磅的胖子。上司只好派他前往日本执行简单的押送疑犯任务，可惜疑犯却逃跑了，但失踪的疑犯却被发现陈尸在东京湾。为完成任务，朱福龙联同一众朋友，协力查出真相!

programme.title: 医医，我不想再病了粤
programme.desc: 多吃蔬果仍会便秘？「大王」安德尊与焦浩轩，林颖彤与狄易达两组嘉宾都带出水、油对排便的重要，营养师讲解两者的作用。排便状况与肠道的好、坏菌息息相关，甚么食物含有益肠道的益生原？放屁是正常生理反应，屁的气味反映身体状况，肠胃肝脏科专科医生解释不同屁味的成因。甚么颜色的粪便反映可能患上大肠癌？大王一组为了突破零的局面，无所不用其极，终于靠反驳成功得分。另外，还会带来一款以奇亚籽制作的健肠布甸。

programme.title: 医医，我不想再病了粤
programme.desc: 脱牙会增加认知障碍风险？嘉宾区永权、陈庭欣、吴幸美、蔡康年分析时都现严重「语障」，还是请牙科医生讲解咀嚼过程与认知功能的关系，脑神经科专科医生亦会讲解认知障碍症的患病原因。即场做一项认知小测试，题目中的动物图案已令嘉宾迷惘？讲到柏金逊症的病征，康年突然「抛书包」，有料到！两种「脑」毛病有何差别？再派出庭欣与幸美进行柏金逊症小测试。中医亦带来一款健脑益智汤水，嘉宾辨别药材同时，亦了解天麻的补脑功效。

programme.title: 巴打秘景游粤
programme.desc: 「巴打」跟随「地胆」梁敏巧深入沙头角，揭开其神秘面貌。一行人先到访「沙头角阿Sa、阿娇」，试用铁镬炮制炒米粉，还趁机学习客家话。位处禁区的中英街，竖立了界石标示香港和深圳的分界。新楼街唐楼群是二级历史建筑，满载旧香港氛围。众人与街坊打成一片，即兴举行常识问答比赛！乘船往荔枝窝，顺道眺望深圳盐田港。巴打寻找客家生活体验村，感受传统乡村生活。在夜空下互诉心事，三位大男孩细谈演艺路上的辛酸，不禁感触。

programme.desc: 区少夫人跟二娘与十一娘搭话，十一娘言语犀利地讥讽区少夫人跟二娘，令徐太夫人很满意；令宜做噩梦，十一娘向临波打听令宜的心结；十一娘跟简师父提起区少夫人袖口的绣样是重要线索，决定扮成丫鬟随简师父去区府。

programme.title: 妈妈要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任劳任怨大半辈子的慈母觉醒切割贪财不孝子】因丈夫早逝，独自抚养四名子女的尹正爱，就如同天下所有的妈妈一样，为了孩子总是愿意牺牲自己，一路从路边的菜贩打拼，多年后与大女儿允姬开了间点心餐厅。正当一切都看似幸福美满时，孩子们的婚姻、事业、学业纷纷出现状况，在面对问题时儿女们总持相反意见，并只贪图母亲的遗产，让正爱深感背叛，在朋友的劝说下，正爱打算不再以孩子为生活重心，并在缘分安排下开始了第二春。

programme.title: 金装律师
programme.desc: 【王牌律师X怪物新人法律界最强拍档真相一触即发！】在韩国顶尖律师事务所KANG&HAM，崔江锡是无人能敌的王牌律师，精准果敢、战无不胜。一次偶然，他遇见高延宇──没有法学背景、未取得律师执照，却拥有怪物般的惊人记忆力。慧眼识珠的江锡破格将他纳入团队，从此两人成为法律界最强黄金拍档。在法庭上纵横捭阖、揭露真相与阴谋，他们并肩作战，也建立深厚情谊，并在爱与抉择间踏上命运的新篇章。

programme.title: 榴莲小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳时空穿越竟重逢前世伴侣】韩国狗血教母林成汉2023年全新力作！朝鲜时代的杜榴莲，虽嫁给丈夫朴一帅，但内心真正爱的是仆人石铁，碍于身分地位的落差，榴莲与石铁始终只能维持主仆关系，石铁更是遭婆婆痛下杀手。榴莲和石铁的儿子朴言，对金素贮一见钟情，两人马上结为夫妻，然而朴言骤然离世，伤痛欲绝的婆媳俩人，竟在月蚀之夜穿越到了现代，并在丹家别墅中再次见到了曾经的爱人、丈夫，在这一世中他们会擦出什么样的火花呢？

programme.title: 欧若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落难千金嫁到三位「恶婆婆」家，受尽欺辱却迷的两位男神团团转！】该剧以豪爽纯洁的爱情故事继续展开，故事发生在大公司名门之女欧若拉遇见与三个姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小说家黄玛玛。

programme.title: 红色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母抛家嫁富豪弃子重生只为揭穿母亲真面目】一段因爱与欲望而撕裂的亲情，点燃了跨越二十年的复仇烈火。年轻时的熙琼为追逐荣华，狠心抛夫弃子，投入旧情人赫相怀抱，却一步步被权力与野心吞噬。她的女儿珍玛在父亲离世、母亲弃养的阴影下成长，怀著深深怨恨潜入熙琼身边，以设计师与「继孙女」的身分逐步揭穿母亲的虚伪面具。母女之间爱恨交织，真相与谎言、亲情与仇恨轮番交锋，最终将迎来一场足以摧毁一切的命运对决。

programme.title: 圣水洞之吻
programme.desc: 【年下实习生朴所罗门恋年上工作狂金智恩，吻出姊弟恋化学效应！！】业界能力顶级的行销组组长姜娜恩，虽是个性冷血的工作狂，但能交出亮眼的工作成绩单。遇上公司内MZ世代又期待恋爱的实习生苏恩浩，两人上年下的相处，因年龄及价值观不同互相嫌弃。却因意外接吻卷入「灵魂交换」事件。之后两人会发生什么有趣的事呢?

programme.title: 红天机
programme.desc: 【国民妹妹金裕贞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭时旸众多男神演员！！】朝鲜时代进入景福宫的绝世美女画工红天机（金裕贞饰），和失明但可以读懂天空和星座的观象监河览（安孝燮饰），风流倜傥的亮明大君（孔明饰)，梦想成为王的周向大君(郭时旸饰)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人类的魔王同时存在展开的奇幻爱情古装剧。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道总裁《飞狐外传》林雨申恋上俏邻居《光芒》蔡文静！】吴忧因车祸意外放男友鸽子惨遭分手，而同样在这场车祸中丧命的是雅曼生物科技总裁何西亚的未婚妻陆芸。吴忧分手后寄情于工作，投入新职场认识了陆芸的妹妹陆蔓，成为了闺蜜。在公事上与何西亚有了合作，不打不相识的这对欢喜冤家，好不容易发展成为恋人,此时发现陆芸在他们之间串连起来的缘分…

programme.title: 圣水洞之吻

programme.title: 妈妈要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任劳任怨大半辈子的慈母觉醒切割贪财不孝子】因丈夫早逝，独自抚养四名子女的尹正爱，就如同天下所有的妈妈一样，为了孩子总是愿意牺牲自己，一路从路边的菜贩打拼，多年后与大女儿允姬开了间点心餐厅。正当一切都看似幸福美满时，孩子们的婚姻、事业、学业纷纷出现状况，在面对问题时儿女们总持相反意见，并只贪图母亲的遗产，让正爱深感背叛，在朋友的劝说下，正爱打算不再以孩子为生活重心，并在缘分安排下开始了第二春。

programme.title: 金装律师
programme.desc: 【王牌律师X怪物新人法律界最强拍档真相一触即发！】在韩国顶尖律师事务所KANG&HAM，崔江锡是无人能敌的王牌律师，精准果敢、战无不胜。一次偶然，他遇见高延宇──没有法学背景、未取得律师执照，却拥有怪物般的惊人记忆力。慧眼识珠的江锡破格将他纳入团队，从此两人成为法律界最强黄金拍档。在法庭上纵横捭阖、揭露真相与阴谋，他们并肩作战，也建立深厚情谊，并在爱与抉择间踏上命运的新篇章。

programme.title: 榴莲小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳时空穿越竟重逢前世伴侣】韩国狗血教母林成汉2023年全新力作！朝鲜时代的杜榴莲，虽嫁给丈夫朴一帅，但内心真正爱的是仆人石铁，碍于身分地位的落差，榴莲与石铁始终只能维持主仆关系，石铁更是遭婆婆痛下杀手。榴莲和石铁的儿子朴言，对金素贮一见钟情，两人马上结为夫妻，然而朴言骤然离世，伤痛欲绝的婆媳俩人，竟在月蚀之夜穿越到了现代，并在丹家别墅中再次见到了曾经的爱人、丈夫，在这一世中他们会擦出什么样的火花呢？

programme.title: 欧若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落难千金嫁到三位「恶婆婆」家，受尽欺辱却迷的两位男神团团转！】该剧以豪爽纯洁的爱情故事继续展开，故事发生在大公司名门之女欧若拉遇见与三个姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小说家黄玛玛。

programme.title: 红色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母抛家嫁富豪弃子重生只为揭穿母亲真面目】一段因爱与欲望而撕裂的亲情，点燃了跨越二十年的复仇烈火。年轻时的熙琼为追逐荣华，狠心抛夫弃子，投入旧情人赫相怀抱，却一步步被权力与野心吞噬。她的女儿珍玛在父亲离世、母亲弃养的阴影下成长，怀著深深怨恨潜入熙琼身边，以设计师与「继孙女」的身分逐步揭穿母亲的虚伪面具。母女之间爱恨交织，真相与谎言、亲情与仇恨轮番交锋，最终将迎来一场足以摧毁一切的命运对决。

programme.title: 圣水洞之吻
programme.desc: 【年下实习生朴所罗门恋年上工作狂金智恩，吻出姊弟恋化学效应！！】业界能力顶级的行销组组长姜娜恩，虽是个性冷血的工作狂，但能交出亮眼的工作成绩单。遇上公司内MZ世代又期待恋爱的实习生苏恩浩，两人上年下的相处，因年龄及价值观不同互相嫌弃。却因意外接吻卷入「灵魂交换」事件。之后两人会发生什么有趣的事呢?

programme.title: 红天机
programme.desc: 【国民妹妹金裕贞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭时旸众多男神演员！！】朝鲜时代进入景福宫的绝世美女画工红天机（金裕贞饰），和失明但可以读懂天空和星座的观象监河览（安孝燮饰），风流倜傥的亮明大君（孔明饰)，梦想成为王的周向大君(郭时旸饰)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人类的魔王同时存在展开的奇幻爱情古装剧。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道总裁《飞狐外传》林雨申恋上俏邻居《光芒》蔡文静！】吴忧因车祸意外放男友鸽子惨遭分手，而同样在这场车祸中丧命的是雅曼生物科技总裁何西亚的未婚妻陆芸。吴忧分手后寄情于工作，投入新职场认识了陆芸的妹妹陆蔓，成为了闺蜜。在公事上与何西亚有了合作，不打不相识的这对欢喜冤家，好不容易发展成为恋人,此时发现陆芸在他们之间串连起来的缘分…

programme.title: 圣水洞之吻
programme.desc: 【年下实习生朴所罗门恋年上工作狂金智恩，吻出姊弟恋化学效应！！】业界能力顶级的行销组组长姜娜恩，虽是个性冷血的工作狂，但能交出亮眼的工作成绩单。遇上公司内MZ世代又期待恋爱的实习生苏恩浩，两人上年下的相处，因年龄及价值观不同互相嫌弃。却因意外接吻卷入「灵魂交换」事件。之后两人会发生什么有趣的事呢?

programme.title: 风起西州
programme.desc: 【《风起霓裳》最新续作！！许魏洲、古力娜扎续夫妻情缘，琴瑟和鸣的婚后生活及事业新考验！！】制衣才女库狄琉璃与裴行俭婚后面对大长公主的屡次使计刁难，琉璃聪慧应对，化险为夷。裴行俭因意外被贬远赴西州上任，夫妻携手同心，琉璃发挥自己的长才，传授西州百姓制衣技巧。裴行俭则守护西州百姓经济富足、安居乐业。

programme.desc: 【《风起霓裳》最新续作！！许魏洲、古力娜扎续夫妻情缘，琴瑟和鸣的婚后生活及事业新考验！！】制衣才女库狄琉璃与裴行俭婚后面对大长公主的屡次使计刁难，琉璃聪慧应对，化险为夷。裴行俭因意外被贬远赴西州上任，夫妻携手同心，琉璃发挥自己的长才，传授西州百姓制衣技巧。裴行俭则守护西州百姓经济富足、安居乐业。

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - What's Hot?
programme.desc: Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken A&amp;amp;E, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and the Penguins give facts about what's hot and what's not.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch wants to watch his favourite DVD in peace, so uses his remote control to pause the Rio Carnival in Brazil!

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Butterflies
programme.desc: Playing 'Butterflies' in the backyard is great fun, until Bluey runs away with Judo leaving Bingo all alone. Now poor Bingo's heartbroken and Bluey needs to make amends.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Piggyback
programme.desc: The Heelers take a long riverside walk, but Bingo's legs are tired, and she wants a piggyback. To distract her, mum and dad invent fun games and get her little legs moving again.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Prairie Dog Pups
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to Chihuahua, Northern Mexico to discover how a colony of black tailed prairie dogs protect their pups from prowling bull snakes, hawks and coyotes as the pups take their critical first steps above ground.

programme.title: Dog Squad (S1) - Mission: Birthday Cake
programme.desc: Guide dog Kika works with Dr Amit to buy what they need for a birthday celebration.

programme.title: Steve and Aneeshwar Go Wild (S1) - Giant Anteater and Chimpanzee
programme.desc: Steve and Aneeshwar meet a giant anteater and give him his breakfast in a long tube. Next, they meet some chimpanzees to find out the wild connection between these two animals.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Pockets
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit Patch in the Cloud Kitchen. He has found a tiny mouse in his pocket, which reminds him of a tasty treat recipe to make with the Playtimers - pocket mouse pitta!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Topiary Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels see Duggee practicing his impressive Topiary skills and are keen to try it.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Favourite Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn what a favourite is, but have trouble deciding their own favourites.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Round Up Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels go on the trail of a lost herd of cattle with Duggee and pal Rodeo Horse.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - Meteorite Mayhem, Wolfe Creek Crater, Australia
programme.desc: The Go Jetters discover what made the Wolfe Creek Crater - a meteorite.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - Puffin Patrol, Iceland
programme.desc: The Westman Islands are home to one of the largest colonies of puffins in the world! Once a year puffins return to the land to lay a single egg.

programme.title: Thomas &amp; Friends (S24) - Thomas and the Forest Engines
programme.desc: In Brazil, Thomas meets two wood-burning engines who've never travelled beyond their eucalyptus railway.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Paisley Sea
programme.desc: The duo think they are heading to the zoo, but the bus takes a surprising diversion.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Rainbow's Niece
programme.desc: Sarah's new colour wheel reminds Rainbow that he has not seen his niece in a while.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Carnival
programme.desc: Stanley, Sophie and Benjamin make up a new game, 'Dino-Pirates'. This is such a good game, they use it as inspiration for Stanley's carnival float.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Bubbles
programme.desc: Stanley cleans Cynthia's bus, but each time he does it keeps getting dirty again. It's so dirty by the end, he invents a super-duper cleaning machine that makes a sea of bubbles.

programme.title: Kazoops! (S1) - Fun With Clouds
programme.desc: A family trip for Monty is ruined by the cloudy weather, and they all wish they would disappear, until Monty and Jimmy take another approach.

programme.title: JoJo &amp; Gran Gran (S2) - It's Time to Visit the Art Gallery
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran visit the art gallery and join a tour with curator Marie to see lots of different types of art. JoJo realises art isn't just for looking at - it's for making too!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Curry Quest
programme.desc: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest, when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Magic
programme.desc: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule: never use magic for cheekiness.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Chest
programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - Tag's First Day
programme.desc: The Squirrels are crafting in the Clubhouse when Betty saves Tag from throwing water across the table instead of glitter.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Library Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels can't figure out if fish have noses, Duggee shows them his library. But when the Squirrels realise no-one is visiting it, they have an idea...

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Campfire Choir
programme.desc: Today at Squirrel Club, there are all sorts of comparisons to learn - from small to smallest, hungry to hungriest, and Duggee to Duggiest!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Easter Island, Chile
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch is on holiday to the remote Easter Island to avoid crowds, but when he arrives he finds droves of tourists everywhere!

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits (S1) - Potato
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp;amp; Fruits theatre, it's Potato dedicating a song to his uncle Spud, who went on a spaceship to the moon.

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits (S1) - Strawberry
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp;amp; Fruits Theatre, it's Strawberry, who used to be insecure, but now can't wait to celebrate herself and sing her song, See the Seeds!

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Museum Mischief

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Broccoli Flies Again

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Spinning
programme.desc: The Teletubbies travel by Tubby Car to the Hidey Hup where they all spin around on the Tubby Spinny.

programme.title: Yakka Dee (S7) - H

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Pockets
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit Patch in the Cloud Kitchen. He has found a tiny mouse in his pocket, which reminds him of a tasty treat recipe to make with the Playtimers - pocket mouse pitta!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Topiary Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels see Duggee practicing his impressive Topiary skills and are keen to try it.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Favourite Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn what a favourite is, but have trouble deciding their own favourites.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Round Up Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels go on the trail of a lost herd of cattle with Duggee and pal Rodeo Horse.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - Meteorite Mayhem, Wolfe Creek Crater, Australia
programme.desc: The Go Jetters discover what made the Wolfe Creek Crater - a meteorite.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - Puffin Patrol, Iceland
programme.desc: The Westman Islands are home to one of the largest colonies of puffins in the world! Once a year puffins return to the land to lay a single egg.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S24) - Thomas and the Forest Engines
programme.desc: In Brazil, Thomas meets two wood-burning engines who've never travelled beyond their eucalyptus railway.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Paisley Sea
programme.desc: The duo think they are heading to the zoo, but the bus takes a surprising diversion.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Rainbow's Niece
programme.desc: Sarah's new colour wheel reminds Rainbow that he has not seen his niece in a while.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Carnival
programme.desc: Stanley, Sophie and Benjamin make up a new game, 'Dino-Pirates'. This is such a good game, they use it as inspiration for Stanley's carnival float.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Bubbles
programme.desc: Stanley cleans Cynthia's bus, but each time he does it keeps getting dirty again. It's so dirty by the end, he invents a super-duper cleaning machine that makes a sea of bubbles.

programme.title: Kazoops! (S1) - Fun With Clouds
programme.desc: A family trip for Monty is ruined by the cloudy weather, and they all wish they would disappear, until Monty and Jimmy take another approach.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S2) - It's Time to Visit the Art Gallery
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran visit the art gallery and join a tour with curator Marie to see lots of different types of art. JoJo realises art isn't just for looking at - it's for making too!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Curry Quest
programme.desc: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest, when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Magic
programme.desc: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule: never use magic for cheekiness.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Chest
programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - Tag's First Day
programme.desc: The Squirrels are crafting in the Clubhouse when Betty saves Tag from throwing water across the table instead of glitter.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Library Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels can't figure out if fish have noses, Duggee shows them his library. But when the Squirrels realise no-one is visiting it, they have an idea...

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Campfire Choir
programme.desc: Today at Squirrel Club, there are all sorts of comparisons to learn - from small to smallest, hungry to hungriest, and Duggee to Duggiest!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Easter Island, Chile
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch is on holiday to the remote Easter Island to avoid crowds, but when he arrives he finds droves of tourists everywhere!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Potato
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp; Fruits theatre, it's Potato dedicating a song to his uncle Spud, who went on a spaceship to the moon.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Strawberry
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp; Fruits Theatre, it's Strawberry, who used to be insecure, but now can't wait to celebrate herself and sing her song, See the Seeds!

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Museum Mischief
programme.desc: Evil Pea pretends to help Supertato and Carrot train for crime prevention, but she tricks them and steals a mobile phone. Supertato and Carrot have a clever plan to get it back.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Broccoli Flies Again

programme.desc: Stanley, Sophie and Benjamin make up a new game, 'Dino-Pirates'. This is such a good game, they use it as inspiration for Stanley's carnival float.

programme.title: Kazoops! (S1) - Car Trip
programme.desc: Monty is surprised that his mum doesn't find her job exciting, and wonders if things become dull if you do them every day.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S2) - It's Time to Press a Flower
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran press a flower so that it will last for a long time. JoJo learns that flowers wilt over time but flower pressing is a special way to make them last longer.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Magic
programme.desc: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule: never use magic for cheekiness.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Chest
programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Hat Badge
programme.desc: King Tiger interrupts the Squirrels' quiet time when he turns up to the Clubhouse with a magic hat on instead of his crown.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - Tag's First Day
programme.desc: The Squirrels are crafting in the Clubhouse when Betty saves Tag from throwing water across the table instead of glitter.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Stick Time
programme.desc: How many siblings does Norrie have? What's Duggee's favourite badge? What does everyone do on Fridays? Squirrel Club has the answers!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Parthenon, Greece
programme.desc: Inspired by his favourite action film, Grand Master Glitch plans to make a blockbuster of his own, but first he needs to find the right setting for an action adventure.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Grapes
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp; Fruits Theatre, it's the spectacular acrobatic grapes working together to perform the most difficult structures to perfection.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Potato
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp; Fruits theatre, it's Potato dedicating a song to his uncle Spud, who went on a spaceship to the moon.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Broccoli Flies Again
programme.desc: Evil Pea asks for flying lessons when Broccoli flies her paper plane into her freezer. Evil Pea doesn't let Broccoli know that she intends to fly high to take over Tato Tower.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Tin Can Games
programme.desc: It's the Tin Can Games and Evil Pea wants to win the Tin Can Trophy. She cheats in the final race by putting a magnet on Supertato's back to stop him from going super fast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Toast
programme.desc: The Teletubbies eat lots of Tubby Toast and make a huge pile of crumbs. Luckily, The Noo-Noo is on hand to clean up.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Lizard
programme.desc: A seasoned burglar 'The Lizard' sets himself up against a corrupt police chief and announced that he will steal a diamond from a rich man's party. His real identity, which is discovered by the corrupt police chief's granddaughter, is actually a young policeman who is doing it all for justice.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: The Gambling Syndicate
programme.desc: A young provincial detective seeks to take down a local gambling syndicate with the help of two convicts.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Li Xun Huan is a sentimental swordsman who has lived peacefully outside the martial arts world for the past ten years. He returns home after knowing that the Plum Blossom Bandit is back to his old tricks, only to find that everything has changed.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiance Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan...

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas' pursuit.

programme.title: Lover's Rock
programme.desc: Pan Lei, winner the China Literary Award for three consecutive years, wrote and directed this film about the lives and loves of a fishing village. It starred the glorious Cheng Pei-pei in her first film as a woman (she had debuted in a man's role), and her much-lauded performance won her the prestigious Golden Accolade Award from the International Association Of Independent Producers a first for any Asian woman.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the "Deer Sword". Lian's wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiao's home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wife's faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: As Monkey and his gang make their way to the West through Fire Mountain, they ran into the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her sexy sister, and have to fight their way through.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: As Monkey and his gang make their way to the West through Fire Mountain, they ran into the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her sexy sister, and have to fight their way through.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tien's gang is helping them; he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young upstart, and soon Wang is in dire straits, in the port of Hong Kong.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to double-cross and outwit one another...

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: Four martial arts experts live in Seoul after the Korean War in the 1950s. One of them inexplicably crosses path with a drug trafficking syndicate, and his three friends have no choice but to fight a brutal battle on his side...

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sister's death, but is shocked to discover that her fiance, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jin's mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kam's empire.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: Swordsman Long meets Feng while searching for his missing father and they soon fall in love and marry. When Long is kidnapped by 'Dragon Gate Palace' one day, Feng embarks on a rescue mission and reunites with Long, who manages to escape. Together, they confront the head of 'Dragon Gate Palace', and uncover a long-hidden secret.

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return...

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: Yang Guo and Xiao Long Nu are deeply in love and live harmoniously in the ancient tomb. Xiao Long Nu proposes marriage one day but Yang Guo declines. Heartbroken, she leaves without a word. Devastated by her absence, Yang Guo searches tirelessly for her. When they finally reunite, he begs her to marry him-only for her to refuse his proposal.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend "Investiture of the Gods", this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his father's death. He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to recover. Little does Dai know this is his chance to take revenge.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu serves his triad society loyally and tries to live a respectable life, but over time his good intentions lead him to an all-out gang war with a startling conclusion.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her father's arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping to challenge Qin Ge-only to be drawn into a deadly plot within the criminal underworld.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: Golden Chicken
programme.desc: Ah Kam, a seasoned prostitute, gets locked inside an ATM vestibule with a thief. Both discover they are ill-fated in life and Ah Kam starts telling him her life story as a prostitute, from a teenage hooker to a PR girl in an upscale club in her thirties, as well as being a strip dancer, bar girl and masseuse.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the "Heartbroken Sword" style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: Man Wanted 3
programme.desc: Street kid Dong idolizes Mongkok triad leader Pu Jun and inadvertently joins his gang. When rival Xi Yang seizes control by illicit means, Pu Jun decides to take him down. At the same time, Pu Jun uncovers Dong as a police undercover and banishes him, but Dong sheds his undercover identity to join Pu Jun to seek revenge against Xi Yang.

programme.title: The Story of Woo Viet
programme.desc: Former Vietnamese veteran Woo Viet arrives a refugee camp in Hong Kong and meets his pen pal Quan. Subsequently, he encounters Shum Ching, with whom he attempts to flee to the US. However, the pair end up stranded in Manila's Chinatown, where at the hands of the local triads Woo becomes a hired killer, while Shum is forced into prostitution.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: City of Desire
programme.desc: Sister 13 returns to Macau after 17 years to succeed her father's underground empire, the prostitution business. She tries to stop their exploitation of the sex workers, but Macau's economy flourished after the handover, propelling the prostitution and gambling businesses. The city is blinded by desire and Sister 13 can do nothing to help...

programme.title: Don't Open Your Eyes
programme.desc: A cop has the ability to see ghosts, which is something that has been passed down from generation to generation in his family. He must learn how to manage this gift when he is confronted by the ghost of a notorious criminal whom he has shot.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip's boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim's sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist's drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Hong Kong tycoon Ren Da Kuan takes care of his family that spans four generations, yet his three sons grapple with their own challenges. Everything changes when his daughter returns from studying in France with her friend Roberto. Roberto brings a wave of transformation to the Ren family, sparking new hope and opportunities for all.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended Version)
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended Version)
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: The Eye 10
programme.desc: This third installment of 'The Eye' horror movie series is about the creepy adventures of a group of teenagers who summon spirits by using the ten methods outlined in a mysterious comic book while vacationing in Thailand.

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: Hao Shi becomes the new triad boss after his father is killed by the pretty swindler, Ling. While professional gunman Drunken Gun is tasked to help Hao Shi take revenge, Ling is hunted by gangster Lei, from whom she has conned 2 million dollars. In the process, Hao Shi and Drunken Gun accidentally arrest Lei instead...

programme.title: Love and Let Love!
programme.desc: Cliff proposes to his girlfriend Terry but is killed in a car accident before she says "yes". Terry is devastated and inconsolable. When Cliff's ghost returns, they seem to go back to their good old days. However, Cliff is determined to help Terry get over his death and start anew.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Wo Hu
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Police has placed more than a thousand undercover officers in various triad groups to bring down the largest criminal organization in Hong Kong. Betrayal, deceit and murder bring this group of "brothers" into a collision with the law and with each other!

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When OCTB (Organized Crime And Triad Bureau) officer, Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs, he seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU (Police Tactical Unit) to find his lost revolver. Ho and his patrolling PTU team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well 97
programme.desc: Mr Lo has three sons, Leung, Fay and Kung; and a daughter-in-law, Eliza. While they seem like a normal family, their relationships need mending. Leung and Fay play a prank on their brother Kung on his birthday by falsely claiming that he has won the lottery. This sets off a chain reaction of funny mishaps that finally brings the family together.

programme.title: A Chinese Tall Story
programme.desc: While finding ways to rescue his disciples, Monk Tripitaka meets the lizard imp Mei Yan, the ugliest woman alive. Despite the conflict between good and evil, he falls for Mei Yan who sacrifices herself to save him many times. The Monk breaks his "no killing" rule to save his disciples, and things get more complicated as Princess Galaxy appears...

programme.title: To the Fore
programme.desc: The cycling team's top sprinter Zheng Zi Yuan teams up with two domestiques, Ming and Tian, who assist him to win the race. When Ming and Tian get tired of sacrificing their own chances to win, an accident causes the team to break up but the trio soon team up again for another race. Who will be the first to cross the line this time?

programme.title: To the Fore
programme.desc: The cycling team's top sprinter Zheng Zi Yuan teams up with two domestiques, Ming and Tian, who assist him to win the race. When Ming and Tian get tired of sacrificing their own chances to win, an accident causes the team to break up but the trio soon team up again for another race. Who will be the first to cross the line this time?

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Tristar
programme.desc: Young priest Hong disguises himself to protect Bai, a prostitute, while Detective Liu investigates her ties to a prostitution ring. Hong finds Bai a lawful job and helps her negotiate with the underworld. Meanwhile, Liu's investigation causes misunderstandings - can he crack down on the gang? How will Hong manage his emotions as Bai falls for him?

programme.title: The Truth
programme.desc: Orphaned lawyer Raymond Lau once helped clear hooker Lan of murder charges, not knowing that Lan is his mother. When a corrupt cop blackmails Lan with Raymond's identity, she kills him out of desperation. When Raymond is enlisted again to defend Lan, he uncovers the secret that she has been hiding about their relationship for years.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: God of Gambler's Return
programme.desc: The God of Gamblers, Gao Jin, quits gambling and live a quiet life with his wife. However, a Taiwanese crime boss wants to become the new God of Gamblers and get rid of him, so he kills Gao Jin's pregnant wife to force him to the casino table. Gao Jin is indignant and vows to fight the crime boss to avenge his wife's death.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair II
programme.desc: After being betrayed by Zhuo, the white-haired witch Lian seeks revenge by slaughtering her way through the eight martial arts clans. However, she is soon attacked by a man whose bride she has abducted. Meanwhile, Zhuo, who is waiting on a hilltop for a flower to bloom for Lian's restoration, hastens to save her upon realizing the danger she is in.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Eddie is hired by the Interpol to capture a human smuggling gang leader known as Snakehead. Eddie dies in an action to protect a sacred child from being kidnapped, but is brought back to life by the child's magical medallion, allowing him to finally kill Snakehead.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Uncharted Territory
programme.desc: Alex and Eugene find themselves at odds with Tom and their fellow dragon riders when Feathers and Webmaster go missing during a blizzard in the Ice Realm.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Journey to the Snowcano
programme.desc: Jun struggles to convince Tom to trust her faith in myths over the Book of Dragons when they venture to a place that his book seems to say is extremely dangerous.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Angry Abnormal Atrocities of the Astute Animal Agressors
programme.desc: Stuck in separate camps, Harold and George unleash a hyperintelligent talking possum to scare the pants off of Krupp. What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Abysmal Altercation of the Abominable Altitooth
programme.desc: Eager to get the campers out of his hair, Krupp orders them to climb Plummet Peak, where a terrifying creature is rumored to reside.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Bizarre Bout of the Beastly Barfilisk
programme.desc: Harold and George don't ask for much -- just a fun scavenger hunt that doesn't include doing Krupp's errands. Careful what you wish for, fellas.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Itty Bitty Blossom
programme.desc: The dollhouse delivery is a special plant called an Itty Bitty Blossom that goes from newborn to full-grown in one day. Gabby and Pandy have to take care of the whiny and fussy growing Itty Bitty Blossom and make sure it is in its permanent soil spot before it's fully grown.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Dollhouse Store Day
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a coin purse with kitty coins, it's Store Day in the dollhouse! Gabby and Pandy help out at all the different stores (Cakey's Bakery, Baby Box's Craft Emporium, Kitty Fairy's Flower Shoppe) to earn kitty coins and save up for a melodicat at the Grand Opening of DJ Catnip’s Music Store!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Fairy's Sleepover
programme.desc: When Gabby, Pandy and the Gabby Cats prepare for a sleepover in the Garden, they discover Pillow Cat has never been to a sleepover. They help her conquer her fears and enjoy her first sleepover.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Let's Make A Movie!
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes two little containers of popcorn and two movie tickets, it’s movie night in the dollhouse! Demanding Director CatRat leads the Gabby Cats through a Gabby-fied version of a classic story, Gabby-locks and the Three Bears.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Pete The Polar Bear
programme.desc: Pete the Polar Bear shows up for a vacation on MerCat’s sunny beach. Gabby, Pandy, and the Gabby Cats show Pete he can have a great vacation, even if things don’t go precisely to plan.

programme.title: Dinotrux S2 - Picktools
programme.desc: When the crew gets stuck on a sheet of thin ice, they run into a group of Picktools, which appear to be trying to crack the ice around them.

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Rumble In The Jungle
programme.desc: Zebby is upset when Raa Raa laughs at her rumbling tummy and runs off to hide. Raa Raa sets out to find his friend and apologise… he thinks it will be easy, he just has to listen out for the sound of her tummy, but who knew how many other rumbling noises there were?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's Favourite Noise
programme.desc: Raa Raa is inspired by his friends to search for his favourite noise in the jingly jangly jungle. The little lion cub and his friends set out to find out what Raa Raa's Favourite Noise could be…

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Ooo Ooo Slips Up
programme.desc: Raa Raa and the other animals keep slipping up on banana skins that are littering the jungle floor. Where could they have come from? Together the animals clear up the mess and discover who has been littering the jungle with banana skins.

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - No Sleep Til Bedtime
programme.desc: It is nap time in the Jingly Jangly Jungle but Raa Raa is not tired and is determined to play hide and seek with his friends, whether they like it or not! But all this running about can be tiring work for a noisy little lion cub…

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's Rainy Day
programme.desc: It is raining in the Jingly Jangly Jungle. Raa Raa is annoyed as he doesn't think he'll be able to play with his friends… until they discover that the rain makes lots of exciting new noises.

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Two's Company
programme.desc: Raa Raa and Crocky inadvertently leave one of the others out of all their games. Will they realise that sometimes games can be more fun the more players you have?

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Deep Trouble
programme.desc: Dak's lack of planning gets him, Cutter and Winger lost with Elbone in the Maze Caves, and Leyla's overthinking threatens the effort to rescue them.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Dark Park Bark Lark \ The Fast and the Curious
programme.desc: Tag and Scooch team up to get all of Scooch's chores done in time for the Barkapellas Bark In the Park In the Dark concert. \ Tag is so excited to join the Sam Whippet’s Race Cadets. But when Tag and Scooch show up at the racetrack, there’s lots of competition. And to complete the first challenge - a pedal car race - they’re going to have to work together.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - CatRat The Bandit
programme.desc: The dollhouse is immersed in imaginative Wild West play with Sheriff Gabby, Sheriff Pandy, and CatRat the Bandit. Sheriff Gabby and Sheriff Pandy must safely deliver gold to the bank, but it gets confiscated by Bandit CatRat! They go on an adventure to get the gold back and restore order in the dollhouse.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - DJ Catnip Gets His Groove Back
programme.desc: Gabby brings DJ Catnip a microphone for him to use in the big music show, but he has some terrible news: he lost his groove! Determined to help him get his groove back, Gabby and Pandy take him on a musical search through the dollhouse. As they go, Gabby uses the microphone to record sounds from the Gabby Cats’ everyday activities that culminate into a new song that gets DJ his groove back just in time for the show! In our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, Gabby sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Fairy Gets Sick
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a recipe for dandelion soup and a soup bowl, she discovers Kitty Fairy is sick! Gabby and Pandy make her some delicious dandelion soup and while she rests, they take care of her Garden. With the help of all the Gabby Cats, they water the Singing Flowers, help the Rainbow Kitty Bushes regain their color, and sing some fussy Itty Bitty Blossoms a lullaby. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Kitty Fairy sings a song!

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Business Boss: Back in Baby
programme.desc: After the events of the Boss Baby 2 film, adult businessman Theodore Templeton is framed for embezzling from his company and forced to revert back to his old Boss Baby self and crash with his brother Tim. But to pull this off, he'll need to win over Tim's family into letting him stay, and convince Baby Corp to give him back his old job... which is currently held by his baby niece Tina.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Stroll
programme.desc: Tina and Boss adjust to co-boss responsibilities while on a mission to rescue the baby with the best hair in the world from a lice outbreak. With opposing leadership views, the two split the existing field team's focus and discover a new archenemy in Lumpy the Park Duck.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Potty Mouth
programme.desc: After a baby says a swear word on live television (censored by child-friendly online filter Sheriff Potty Pardner), Boss becomes obsessed with proving that the baby was taught this filth by their new arch-nemesis, Lumpy the Park Duck. Meanwhile, Tina's search to find what that swear word means creates unintentional havoc for both Tabitha's research paper and for Baby Corp's online systems when Sheriff Potty Pardner gives them an "internet time out"

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Imaginary Friends
programme.desc: After Boss insults Tina's imaginary friend, he's forced into "Imaginary Friend Sensitivity Training" at Baby Corp. Boss makes up his own imaginary friend to get out of these meetings, but after Tina gets a whiff that he may be lying, he's forced to keep up the charade at work and at home.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Turf War
programme.desc: It's a turf war when Bounce House Bruiser Baby encroaches on Delivery Baby's tricycle park! Tina attempts to befriend Bruiser in order to woo her back to the bounce house, but naughty behavior is the only language Bruiser understands. Determined to win this kid over, Tina ends up going rogue as a trike hoodlum, and her own field team is forced to reign her in.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Trading Up
programme.desc: Boss takes an overdue vacation day, and ends up teaching Tabitha the value of "trading up" valueless objects into something she actually wants, an electric scooter. However, a 5%er baby is in trouble and BB's field team has "got it under control"… or do they? Boss tries to juggle his Tabitha lessons with sneaking peeks at the mission in progress

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - War of the Cheeks
programme.desc: Boss searches for evidence that Tabitha's best friend is an Uncuddleable, but is sidetracked by a Templeton Family tradition: "The War of the Cheeks", a Go Fish tournament where the winner gets to make family rules for a whole day. When Yvette joins in, Boss has to keep her from winning, out of fear that an evil babysitter will make family rules that overturn the Templeton household.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Techy Tykes
programme.desc: Trying to win Tabitha's loyalty for Baby Corp, Boss and Tina invite her to Techy Tykes, a technology convention at their office. But when the top-secret UBO goes missing, the outsiders Tabitha and Tim (who's tagged along to relive his glory days) immediately become the number one suspects.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Birthday Blues
programme.desc: Missing his old life on his birthday, Boss tries to have a full-fledged grown-up celebration in Chicago, but Carol is the only one able to chauffeur and take care of him. The two battle at every stop of the birthday party tour, but when Boss's old work nemesis sets him up for an Federal Investigation Sting at an improv comedy show, Boss and Carol are forced to work together to escape the law.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Sitting Ducks
programme.desc: Boss, Tina, JJ, Dez and Pip willfully get babysat by the Uncuddleables, planning to expose them as horrible sitters via secret, hidden cameras. But the plan is thrown for a loop when Tina's first night alone without her parents makes her fall for their sitter Mia as a "substitute mommy." Meanwhile, Nannycam uses the babysitting distraction to sneak into the Uncuddleables' secret garage hideout to gather intel with her own "B field team."

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Big Dumpling
programme.desc: The Uncuddleables have struck the Lil Dumpling baby pageant, replacing all of Baby Corp's super-cute top 5%er babies with not-cute bottom 5%ers. Boss, Tina and their field team race to caravan the 5%ers from their homes to the pageant before Nannycam deploys the nuclear option of unleashing the dangerously cute UBO on stage to salvage a Lil Dumpling win.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Great Medieval London Fire 1135
programme.desc: Boss Baby and Tina reject the 5%er system that says the cuter you are, the more love you deserve. Teaming up with the Uncuddleables, the team tries to take down the system from within, forming a resistance of the eight department heads of Baby Corp in the hopes of changing the way we look at Baby Love forever.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Untitled Templeton Project
programme.desc: Fired from Baby Corp and trying to build their own business, Boss Baby and Tina waste all their startup funds immediately, requiring a loan from Banker Baby Benny. In order to receive their seed money and get their company rolling, they have to rebuild the town’s faith in a baby who made everyone miss a huge sporting even (and they have to do it on a very limited budget)

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Puppy Love
programme.desc: Unable to land baby clients, Boss and Tina take in a naughty little puppy as a side hustle, trying to earn a little extra scrap. But once they discover the dogs in the neighborhood are stealing for a puppy trainer named Becker, the mission gets much bigger, and our team is forced to earn a little Puppy Love for once.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Biscuits Rising
programme.desc: Lured into an empty hotel where a baby has supposedly gone missing, the team is trapped by Crispin Biscuits, a chaotic British schoolboy baby who’s been hired to wreck Boss and Tina’s lives. Crispin puts the new company’s loyalty to a test in a series of fiendish puzzling mind games, all with the threat of constant balloon popping (horrible for baby ears!)

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Moon Shot
programme.desc: Our team’s startup company and their rivals at Baby Corp get in a "Space Race", competing to see who can make the cutest kiddie-pretend "moon landing" for a baby - a spectacle sure to bring in a bounty of Baby Love. With both companies pouring their resources into a simulated space take off, tempers and sabotage are running hot, and the scrappy little startup is in danger of getting crushed by their big business competitor.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Inner Children
programme.desc: JJ reluctantly lets Tina take over her assistant duties for the day, but a Tina slip-up leads to an outbreak of town adults drinking diluted special formula that makes them all baby-brained. When JJ discovers this, she works with R & D Baby Simmons and Security Baby Katja to antidote the wobbling "Adult Babies" before Tina can find out and blame herself.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Poompf!
programme.desc: Crispin Biscuits frames Boss and Tina’s startup company for exploding baby Iggy’s favorite stuffed animal, and Tina is forced to the sidelines to avoid any more bad press. As Crispin expands his plan to burst all the plush toys in the neighborhood, Tina discovers she can stop this by breaking open and rewiring a single toy doll. Unfortunately that doll is Baby Corp’s current head honcho, Pull-String CEO Baby.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Heat is On
programme.desc: On the hottest week of the year and a miserable time for babies, Boss and Tim infiltrates a country club with a very cool splash pad in order to find some way around their strict "no-babies" policy. Meanwhile, Banker Baby Benny visits the startup company to check on his investment. Tina has to cover up how the heat has split her coworkers into lawless factions fighting over a fan and a mist cooler.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Who's a Good Baby?

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Yellow 100
programme.desc: Finally promoted to CEO, Boss Baby sets his sights on achieving 100% Baby Love, while dealing with the annoying Puppies and Preeks who rented Baby Corp office space while Boss was gone. Tim and Danny become local heroes after saving a baby's life.

programme.desc: Topsy is going to read Zebby a naptime story. Raa Raa wants to make the noises to go with the story. But they are all too loud and poor Zebby can't get to sleep. Can Raa Raa find any quiet sleepy noises in the Jingly Jangly Jungle?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Go Bananas
programme.desc: Ooo Ooo is having a banana party. Raa Raa and the others have picked masses of lovely bananas, but how are they going to transport them back to Ooo Ooo's in time for the party?
